title: Choose the visual world for umerjahangier.com
question: The roll assigned Magma Chamber, which is also the literal reading of your brief. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Magma Chamber
options.lineage: volcanic caves and foundry floors; the brief's own image
options.thesis: You are underground. Cooled black rock carries the content; magma glows in the fissures; the cursor is heat, and wherever it moves the rock warms and lights up. Scrolling descends. It refuses the floating-3D-blob-over-dark-hero portfolio.
options.viewport: Full-bleed WebGL chamber. A basalt floor with faint magma cracks; MUHAMMAD UMER in a heavy industrial display face across the lower third, lit from below by a vent; one line: 'I build AI products end to end: LLM agents, real-time voice, multi-tenant SaaS.' Two basalt-slab actions: Email me / Download CV. Move the mouse and the rock heats and glows under it. A single 'descend' cue.
options.risk: Darkness can eat legibility and the effect can read as a lava lamp; mobile GPUs need a half-resolution heat pass with bloom off.

raised.raise: Everything is measured against one strict ten-division grid; motion is continuous, never a random flicker.
State is physical and persistent: a project you touched keeps an ember mark for the visit.
Project castings share one exact scale and ground so their numbers compare honestly across pages.
One 2D heat map drives everything: the WebGL floor, the DOM glow and the button states read the same data.
Heat and glow artifacts are tied to real data (contribution intensity, hover, scroll depth), never applied as a generic filter.

options.label: Cyclorama City
options.lineage: your GitHub skyline, taken into three dimensions
options.thesis: The night city of your GitHub profile becomes a walkable 3D skyline: one building per project, warm windows for private work, the cursor a searchlight.
options.viewport: A skyline at night filling the frame, your name set into the sky, buildings lit by contribution data; the pointer sweeps a searchlight across the towers.
options.risk: 3D city portfolios are familiar; this is where most runs in the category land, though it is the most brand-coherent.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: The portfolio as a 2am demoscene intro: one bitmap face on an emissive void, projects riding baselines at depth, dust fields drifting behind at layered speeds, nothing ever boxed.
options.viewport: Your name as one ivory bitmap line dead still on black, three star fields parallaxing behind, an amber caret blinking.
options.case: Wins audience identification with engineers (a real screen tradition, game-like by nature); loses product clarity because one bitmap face at two sizes cannot carry dense project prose and numbers.
options.risk: Reads as retro novelty for non-technical recruiters.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on a signal bench
options.case: Fuses to the voice-agent pipeline as traces, but recruiters do not identify with a signal bench and prose forced into readouts loses clarity.
options.kept: The strict measured grid and continuous sweep.

options.label: Teen Magazine Quiz
options.case: Wrong audience and wrong register for an AI engineer's proof of production work.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.lineage: one plant through five seasonal plates
options.case: Cream paper and engraving are the opposite of the pinned immersive, game-like brief.
options.kept: Fixed-scale registered plates that make comparison honest.

options.label: Curved-Crease Shell
options.lineage: a disc folded along one curved crease
options.case: Elegant but paper-quiet; it cannot carry the required 3D intensity or the cursor-heat interaction.
options.kept: One 2D source drives the whole 3D form.

options.label: Hand-Processed Film
options.case: Cinematic, but the audience identifies with running systems, not film stock, and frame rows fight the product's numbers.
options.kept: Artifacts tied to exact events, never a generic filter.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark hero, huge name, a floating 3D shape, a project grid, a contact form; executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Centered name over a rotating 3D object, three project cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from ten thousand developer portfolios by design.
